old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a white marble track with a red ball rolling along it. The track is intricately designed with various curves and loops, set against a plain white background. The camera remains static, capturing the movement of the red ball as it navigates the track's undulating S-shaped curve. The ball rolls along this continuous curve, highlighting the complexity of the track's layout. The lighting is bright, casting subtle shadows to the right that accentuate the contours of the track and the ball's glossy surface. The overall scene is minimalist, emphasizing the interplay between the ball and the track without any additional elements or distractions.

The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the movement of the red ball as it navigates through the track's twists and turns. The ball rolls smoothly, demonstrating the precision and smoothness of the track's design. As the ball progresses, it encounters different sections of the track, including a straight path and a loop, highlighting the complexity of the track's layout. caption: The video showcases a close oblique view of a long white board with a serpentine groove against an off-white wall. A glossy red ball is already rolling in the channel. The ball rises over rounded crests and drops into troughs, advancing relative to the board as its vertical position oscillates. A thin diagonal seam shifts toward the left frame edge, showing the camera tracking along the surface rather than staying fixed. The ball crosses the seam from left to right while remaining near the center of the view. A bright highlight moves across the ball's curved surface, and pale wood becomes more visible at the lower-right edge. The rolling continues through the last frame without showing how the ball entered the groove or where the track leads afterward.
